nativeProofProvenance: The final change after native runs restricted observer state values to ACTIVE/DONE/ERROR or null and extended the privacy assertion. The MCP transport and native identity checks were unchanged; the full 170-test suite was rerun.

limitations: First explicit native authorization in Co2bZv ended in HTTP 502; exact historical rejection cause unavailable; later correlated round trips passed.
Native JSON positive and A-cancel/B-continue passed in both layouts; SSE positive was tested with protocol fixtures only.
Physical native worker restart/orphan, unregistered native tool and native credential transplantation were not run; fixture coverage is not native proof.
No independent OS containment for the entire AGY lifecycle was validated. Production guards remain closed.
Late HTTP 410 was proved after native end and before app.close in the cancellation runs; older positive runs only observed a closed transport.
CLI auto-updated itself in early runs. Later runs used a disposable hash-pinned 1.4.11 copy with a read-only file-sharing lease; global preferences unchanged.
Native approval waits ended around five minutes despite longer configured deadlines; responsible native layer not proved.
No real OpenCode production or authorized Traycer A2A session tested.
